headline: NVDA, CAT, GLD, TLT hit multi-measure oversold extremes on CEO shock + hawkish Fed; XLE Iran spike is the key fade candidate; NVDA Nov 17 earnings is the dominant landmine.
Semis and tech deeply oversold on Nvidia CEO shock — but governance binary makes NVDA itself untradeable as a clean mean-reversion; overbought defensives stretch on rotation; vol not spiking.
CPI shock created deep oversold extremes in gold, industrials & AI chips — reversion thesis is real, but rate-hike regime and NVDA binary are the landmines.
AI/tech selloff leaves semis deeply oversold with intact fundamentals — energy oversold on Iran peace hopes, healthcare overbought on defensive rotation; CPI is the live landmine.
Energy crash & semi selloff flood the oversold table — oil unwind and NVDA CEO probe create credible reversion setups, but NVDA earnings in 8 days is the key landmine.
